name: All Fours
description: All Fours is a classic trump trick-taking game defined by four scoring elements: High, Low, Jack, and Game. This base profile follows the Trinidad structure, with related English and North American forms listed as variations.

content.text: All Fours is a classic trump trick-taking game defined by four scoring elements: High, Low, Jack, and Game. This base profile follows the Trinidad structure, with related English and North American forms listed as variations.
All Fours emerged in England in the 17th century and later spread to North America and the Caribbean.
2-4 players; with 4, fixed partnerships across the table.
Deal six cards to each player, then turn one card up for provisional trumps.

items.text: Trinidad All Fours: Anticlockwise play, beg/take-one flow, target commonly 14, with hang-jack convention in many tables.
West Yorkshire All Fours: Pitch-led trump (no turn-up), scoring target 11, and regional partnership signaling/throw-in conventions.
Lancashire All Fours: Related to Yorkshire form, but Low can be awarded to trick winner of the low trump.
North American Seven Up / Old Sledge: Clockwise forms with gift/run options, often to 7 or 10, and tie conventions for Game point.
17th-Century All Fours: Two-player historical form from Cotton with related run-card and scoring details.
